vetSays.line: 🛡️ Lauren, Larry, Bessie and Tikhon met them at the door — 4 put down. Lauren, Larry, Bessie, Tikhon are hurt.
🛡️ Bessie, Pilar, Aroha and Dale met them at the door — 4 put down. Bessie, Pilar, Aroha, Dale are hurt.
🛡️ Bessie, Aroha, Farid and Jesse met them at the door — 4 put down. Bessie, Aroha, Farid, Jesse are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Farid just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Bessie, Pilar, Aroha and Dale met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Bessie, Pilar, Aroha, Dale are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Bessie just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jesse met them at the door — 1 put down. Jesse is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jovan just put down Old Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stan just put down Old Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Aki met them at the door — 1 put down. Aki is hurt.

regDeaths.name: the absence of sound, shaped like wings
a soft green glow under the water
something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log
